case_number: 2024 INSC 523; Criminal Appeal No. ? of 2024 (@ Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 11461 of 2022, 11824 of 2022)
summary: Sentencing for bigamy under IPC s.494; standard: proportionality of punishment to gravity/manner; undue leniency undermines societal conscience; inadequate sentence enhancement sought; prior cases emphasized deterrence, societal protection; conviction upheld but sentence enhanced due to gravity of offence and societal impact.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction restored; sentence enhanced to three years rigorous imprisonment with fine.
